title: Predictive headroom allocator and tenant-aware packing advisor for dedicated fleets
creator: Nora Patel
description: Problem: Customers running Redwood Dedicated pools struggle to pick committed capacity and autoscaling parameters that balance SLA headroom and cost. Current metrics are reactive (utilization dashboards) and provide coarse heuristics. Goal: build an automated recommendation pipeline that predicts short-term headroom risk per pool and suggests tenant-aware packing and resize actions with confidence bands, plus a what-if simulator for trade-off exploration. The feature should be actionable from Console and exportable as a CSV/Playbook for sales/CS.
acceptance_criteria: Daily predictive headroom score computed per dedicated pool and stored in metrics with a 95th percentile error < 8% on backtest (last 90 days)
Packing advisor that suggests node-level reallocation and tenant-tenant co-location constraints; suggestions ranked with expected monthly $ savings and estimated risk of SLO violation
Console UI surface that lists top-5 recommended actions for a pool and a link to run a 7-day what-if simulation; actions can be applied as a patch to autoscaling policy
API endpoint for exporting recommendations as CSV and an internal webhook for implementable resize plans
End-to-end e2e tests that cover metric ingestion, model scoring, recommendation generation and Console rendering
milestones: Phase 1 - telemetry and feature engineering (2026-03-08 to 2026-03-18): finalize signals and backtest dataset
Phase 2 - modeling and offline recommendations (2026-03-19 to 2026-03-28): train forecasting and risk models, generate POC suggestions
Phase 3 - API + Console surface (2026-03-29 to 2026-04-06): implement endpoints, UI, and simulator
Phase 4 - rollout and monitoring (2026-04-07 to 2026-04-14): gradual rollout to pilot customers and validate savings
tasks: Define telemetry contract: per-pool per-minute token-in, active-connections, queue-length, avg-latency, preemptible-allocations
Implement feature pipeline in metrics: sliding-window aggregates, peak-mode detection, tenant-aggregation tags
Build forecasting model (Prophet + gradient-boosted residual model) and validate on 6 months of historical pools
Engineer a packing optimizer that respects tenant affinity/anti-affinity and per-tenant SLOs (greedy + local search baseline)
Add API to emit ranked recommendations and risk score; include confidence intervals
Design Console mockups and usability test with Solutions Engineering
Integrate with autoscale policy manager to apply recommended min/max slab adjustments as canary
Create alerting for model drift and recommendation regressions
notes: We intentionally avoid a single monolithic ML model for packing; using hybrid rules + optimizer reduces production risk and simplifies explainability
Trade-offs: aggressive packing increases savings but raises cross-tenant tail latency risk. Recommendations include a conservative option + experimental option with estimated risk
We will instrument a dry-run mode where suggested reconfigs are applied to synthetic simulator before any real changes
Consider using in-house anomaly detector from reliability team for headroom triggers to reduce false positives
Initial customers for pilot: two enterprise accounts in EU with predictable nightly traffic, plus an internal Redwood sample pool

implementation_plan: 1) Deploy feature pipeline to staging and run backtests for 90 days of historical data. 2) Run dry-run packing proposals on simulator for at least 7 days and collect tail-latency risk metrics. 3) Ship Console surface in read-only mode to internal team and pilot customers. 4) Enable apply-as-canary flow behind flag; expose rollback. 5) Measure realized savings and SLO impact for 30 days, iterate on risk thresholds.
rollback_plan: Recommended actions are gated: any applied autoscale patch will be deployed as a canary to 10% of nodes in pool and monitored for 24h. If tail-latency or error rate delta exceeds threshold, auto-rollback to prior policy. Manual override available in Console.
qa_notes: Unit tests for scheduler and solver determinism
Integration test that runs end-to-end with synthetic traffic generator and validates no SLO regressions in dry-run
Load test to validate recommendation generation latency under 10k pools (target < 300ms per pool)
